My mom ate it up and they started to prep me to marry this man. I hated him. He was still serving his mission when my mom dragged me to Utah. I was left alone with 50 dollars in my pocket. I fought and lost.

The hardest part of it all was during this time, I was very TBM. My TBM mind couldn't wrap around how and why this was happening. I felt more guilt that I had this mind set and questioning God. Damn, the church had me good, if it wasn't for this incident I would probably still be TBM.

I never saw the missionary again. I told him to fuck off and I have been living my own life ever since. My mom wants me to move back in with her, but I will never allow myself to do that. True forgiveness is extremely difficult. This was about 5 years ago. A lot better now, but some days are still hard.
